comments.author: Perfect-Builder4321
comments.body:
The fins circling under the water before it surfaces are a great tell. You know something big is coming before the health bar even shows up. And "jump the strike, then hit its head" is a really readable counter loop, especially riding up its body like that.

One thing from doing bosses in my own game: first-time players mostly don't read prompt text mid-fight. If the head flashed or got a glow during the window where you can hit it, I think people would get it even without the "X / click" line. Does the serpent always come from the same side, or does it follow the wave?

replies.author: hyphen_ai
replies.body: good call on the glow, the text is kind of a crutch right now. i'll try flashing the head during the hit window and see if people get it without the prompt. right now it always comes from the same side, making it follow the wave is next
